title: AI Chat Widget - Basic Conversation Flow
description: Verify that the AI chat widget initializes properly, sends and receives messages with typing indicators and maintains message history.

steps.description: Navigate to the Contact Page with Live Chat widget
Check that AI chat widget loads and displays greeting message automatically
Send a simple message from user input
Verify typing indicator shows during AI response preparation
Verify AI response is received within 3 seconds and shown in chat history
Send multiple sequential messages
Verify full conversation history is correctly maintained and displayed without repetition in AI responses

title: Intent Detection Accuracy and Category Mapping
description: Verify intent detection classifies user queries into billing, technical, safety, account, profile_match, and general categories with over 95% accuracy.

steps.description: Send sample messages covering all six intent categories
Verify server /api/detect-intent classifies messages into correct categories
Validate classification accuracy by comparing with expected intents for each sample message
Send ambiguous or mixed intent messages
Verify intent detection selects the most relevant intent category appropriately

title: Information Extraction Auto-fill Functionality
description: Validate that user details like name, email, phone, and subject are correctly extracted from conversation and auto-filled in the contact form with at least 98% accuracy.

steps.description: Engage in chat conversation providing user details naturally
Trigger information extraction API or wait for auto-fill event
Verify contact form fields are populated with correct extracted information
Provide partial or incorrect info in chat to test extraction robustness
Check that extraction does not inaccurately populate fields if information is ambiguous or missing

title: FAQ Search Functionality with AI Enhancement
description: Ensure FAQ search returns relevant answers for 8 predefined commonly asked questions with AI enhancements.

steps.description: Input queries related to the 8 predefined FAQ topics in the chat
Verify FAQ search API returns accurate and contextually relevant answers
Input ambiguous or slightly off-topic questions
Confirm AI enhancement refines the search to provide the closest possible FAQ responses

title: Smart Routing Suggestion Accuracy
description: Test that the smart routing API correctly recommends best support channel (email, phone, ticket, chat) based on intent and priority.

steps.description: Simulate user queries belonging to different intents and priority levels
Verify /api/smart-route suggests appropriate routing channel consistent with query context
Provide edge cases such as urgent safety issues or complex billing questions
Validate routing prioritizes urgent and complex issues towards real-time channels or ticket creation

title: Automated Ticket Creation and Metadata Verification
description: Verify tickets are created with unique IDs (HM-XXXXXXXX), proper priority levels, sentiment data, conversation summaries, and user information included.

steps.description: Trigger creation of a support ticket after a chat session
Verify ticket ID format matches HM-XXXXXXXX pattern
Validate ticket contains correct priority category aligned with detected urgency
Check that sentiment and conversation summary fields accurately represent chat content
Ensure user details are correctly attached to the ticket

title: Sentiment Analysis Accuracy and UI Indication
description: Test sentiment analysis detects each of the 18 possible emotions correctly and updates the UI visual indicators accordingly.

steps.description: Send chat messages crafted to represent the 18 distinct emotions
Verify sentiment API detects the correct emotion for each message
Check UI sentiment indicators update correctly to represent detected emotions

title: Automatic Language Detection and Localization
description: Confirm language detection accurately identifies user message language, adjusts UI language, and AI responses localize properly.

steps.description: Send messages in supported multiple languages
Verify language detection API returns correct language code
Confirm UI elements adapt language accordingly
Check AI responses are localized to detected language
Send mixed language inputs
Validate language detection handles or defaults correctly without breaking UI or logic

title: Smart Quick Replies Dynamic Suggestion Validation
description: Validate the presence of three AI-generated quick reply options that refresh dynamically based on conversation context.

steps.description: Engage in chat and progress conversation through several turns
Verify three quick reply suggestions appear after each user message
Check that quick replies are contextually relevant to the current discussion
Select a quick reply to send
Verify chat advances appropriately and quick reply options update accordingly

title: Conversation Summary Generation Quality
description: Test auto-generation of conversation summaries that capture main issues, user concerns, and suggested solutions in clear 2-3 sentences.

steps.description: Complete a diverse chat session covering multiple topics
Trigger /api/summarize-conversation endpoint
Verify summary contains key user issues and solutions clearly and concisely
Confirm summary length and readability meet criteria

title: Smart Escalation Triggering
description: Ensure automatic escalation of complex, urgent, or sensitive issues routes chat to human agents without false positives.

steps.description: Send messages simulating high urgency or sensitive issues
Verify /api/should-escalate triggers human agent escalation
Send messages for simple or low priority issues
Confirm no false escalation occurs for low priority cases

title: Priority Detection Consistency
description: Verify priority detection accurately categorizes issues as low, medium, or high urgency aligned with user sentiment and issue seriousness.

steps.description: Send chat messages with varying urgency levels indicated by wording and sentiment
Verify system detects and assigns corresponding priority levels correctly
Cross-validate priority with sentiment analysis results for consistency

title: Context Memory and Non-Repetitive AI Responses
description: Test that the context memory maintains full conversation history in AI processing and prevents repetitive or irrelevant responses.

steps.description: Carry out a long multi-turn conversation with references to earlier topics
Verify AI responses correctly incorporate prior context without repetition
Confirm no loss of context over time or after topic switches

title: Proactive Assistance Identification and Guidance
description: Validate that the system identifies when a user needs assistance proactively and offers relevant help without disrupting user experience.

steps.description: Simulate user confusion or inactivity that should trigger proactive assistance
Verify proactive assistance prompt appears timely and is context appropriate
Ensure proactive help can be easily accepted or dismissed by user

title: Error Handling: Network Failure and API Downtime
description: Verify system behavior when backend AI or APIs fail or timeout, ensuring graceful degradation and user notification.

steps.description: Simulate network failure or backend API downtime during chat interaction
Verify user receives clear error messages or fallback UI without freezing
Confirm chat UI recovers gracefully when services are restored

title: Security: Injection and Data Validation in Input Fields
description: Test input sanitization for chat messages, contact form fields and verify resistance to common injection attacks.

steps.description: Attempt to submit SQL injection, script tags, or malformed data via chat and contact form
Verify inputs are sanitized and no harmful code is executed or stored
Check system does not expose sensitive data or crash

title: Performance: AI Chat Response Time Under Load
description: Ensure AI chat responses are delivered within 3 seconds under normal and moderate load conditions.

steps.description: Simulate multiple concurrent chat sessions
Measure response time for each AI reply, ensuring 95% are under 3 seconds

title: UI: Contact Form Auto-Fill Verification
description: Ensure that the contact form fields are auto-filled from chat correctly and user can manually override values.

steps.description: Enter user details in chat to trigger auto-fill
Check that contact form fields get populated automatically
Manually edit auto-filled fields in the contact form
Verify the manual changes persist and form validation works correctly

title: Integration: Human Agent Escalation Workflow
description: Validate end-to-end workflow for smart escalation from AI chat to human agent including notification and handoff summary.

steps.description: Trigger issue requiring escalation in chat
Verify AI flags issue for escalation and chat is routed to human agent
Check human agent receives conversation summary and user context
Agent responds and chat continues smoothly after escalation
Verify conversation history and metadata remain intact

title: Navigation and Routing Verification
description: Ensure main navigation routes correctly to Contact, Support, Locations, and Help pages.

steps.description: Click navigation links for Contact, Support, Locations, Help
Confirm page route updates and correct page content is displayed
Test browser back and forward buttons
Verify routing behaves correctly and state is preserved
